slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Continental survey (October 2016 round, 39 respondents) reported as counts of countries; Nigeria appears only in the annex score bands (digitization composite under 35%, the lowest band; legal framework 80-100%; planning and coordination 65-79%), which name no system and do not say how or where Nigerian offices make the record, so no aspect value can be taken.
